study.name: Retest: Phase 2b: H7 Temperature — Track 1 (brief-text-image)
study.description:
Tests 5 temperature levels at the best image-using M/E from Phase 2a
(brief-text-image, F1=0.4617). Results inform temperature used in
subsequent image-track phases (2c-2e).

Dual-track context: Phase 2a found text-only brief-text (F1=0.5425)
outperformed all image-using conditions, but no pairwise differences
survived FDR correction. Both the best text-only and best image-using
M/E levels are carried forward independently. See Decision 16.
study.retest_notes: H7 temperature Track 1 (image-using). T=0.0 runs redundant but cheap.
